column4: Records the setting of use -- home versus clinic -- not a response to the product.

column1: Therapeutic product ineffective for unapproved indication
column4: Product-worded variant of the same indication-plus-efficacy statement.
Records that the indication was not captured; a completeness note about the report itself.
Lack of effect. Genuinely reportable and worth studying, but it is the absence of benefit rather than the presence of harm, and left in it ranks products by how often they disappoint.
The treated disease got worse. Without the indication field this cannot be separated from the disease simply progressing, so it measures who is sick rather than what the drug did. L-004.
Partial lack of effect, worded for the product rather than the drug.
The patient did not respond; the same absence of benefit.

Partial response. Efficacy, not harm.

The wrong amount was given; a dosing error.
